title: Taxonomy
description: A classification scheme of a site (e.g. 'category', 'tag', 'series') and its rules: hierarchy, who may create terms, how many terms an entry takes, and how its archives are published. Terms are separate nodes (term.schema.json) that point here by id (RFC-0002).

key.description: Stable name of the taxonomy, unique per site and immutable once created. ContentEntry.terms and filter expressions use it (e.g. 'category:news').

labels.description: Display names per locale. Must contain the site's default locale.

hierarchical.description: Terms may have a parent term (categories). Flat when false (tags).

allowNewTerms.description: Who may add terms. none: people only. propose: agents may create terms with status 'proposed' that wait for a person. free: agents may create active terms.

required.description: An entry in review or published status must have at least one term of this taxonomy and an explicit primary term.

maxPerEntry.description: Most terms of this taxonomy one entry may carry. Absent: the contract limit of 50.

collections.description: Collections this taxonomy applies to. Absent: every collection.

feed.description: Publish an RSS feed per term at <archive.basePath>/<slug>/rss.xml. Requires archive.enabled.

minEntriesToIndex.description: Archives listing fewer published entries than this are served with robots 'noindex, follow' and left out of the sitemap.
